metadataServiceCompatibility.policy: When an MSAPI skill capability requires a minimum MetadataService server version, record the capability dependency here and keep generated skill package config.json in sync.

minimumByCapability.label: Object profile defaults and independent page-layout assignment
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires missing-system-administrator permission completion, assignment-free standalone layout create/clone, and standalone profile assignment with optional main record type.

minimumByCapability.label: Lookup and master-detail inverse related-list persistence parity
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires setup-svc-compatible custom inverse related lists, aee/afa/bcb generated identities, required childrelationName validation, and natural-key convergence of historical relationship rows.

minimumByCapability.label: Report and dashboard safe persistence
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires distinct dashboard root update and aggregate replacement, tri-state child collections, Matrix two-row persistence validation, totalrecord runtime closure, complete owned-row cleanup, and fail-closed report delete reference guards.

minimumByCapability.label: Business data Bulk staged streaming and batch DML
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires staged NDJSON/CSV stream endpoints, server-side staged row execution, batch DML for Bulk update/delete/upsert paths, chunk-level automatic-number range allocation, and compact success-result persistence.

minimumByCapability.label: Page layout auto-design and complete content planning
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires empty-content layout create to auto-design metadata-backed sections/buttons/relatedLists with basic short fields balanced into two columns, explicit auto|explicit|clone|blank content modes, exact-source cloning, natural-scope standalone reassignment, and replacement-safe updates.

minimumByCapability.label: Profile source-copy create and existing-infoset state update
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires standard profile create to clone a read-back source unless blank=true is explicit, and update to fail closed unless each permission change targets an existing infoset row owned by the profile while changing state fields only.

minimumByCapability.label: Lightning dashboard aggregate create and runtime visibility readback
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires complete Lightning folder/root/component/filter planning, a 15-component guard, dedicated dashboard list/detail routes, and read-only runtime folder visibility diagnostics.

minimumByCapability.label: Isolated business-data Bulk API
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires the default-off isolated direct-write Bulk API, physical-table writer, independent job ledger, and data:bulk security scopes.

minimumByCapability.label: Button URL field normalization for single and batch create
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService to accept setup-web aligned custom button events lightning, lightning-script, lightning-url, and URL; map user-facing template/url aliases to the persisted setup-svc event values; persist the effective URL consistently for single-button and buttons[] batch specs; and reject conflicting url/functionCode payloads before apply.

minimumByCapability.label: Field ID generation and picklist option natural-key reuse
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService to generate setup-svc-compatible ffe field IDs when create/upsert omits id, reject incident-shaped caller-derived f_ci_* field IDs, and reuse or fail closed on local picklist tp_sys_code option natural keys instead of creating duplicate rows.

minimumByCapability.label: Menu default all-profile visibility and all-application links
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService to default omitted or empty menu profile/application selections to all runtime tp_sys_profile and tp_sys_app rows, write enabled setup-svc tab visibility with tabState=show, and only limit visibility/application links when explicit collections are supplied.

minimumByCapability.label: Complete page layout detail capabilities
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService to plan setup-web/setup-svc page layout detail capabilities for PC layouts, mobile layouts, row layouts, hover layouts, and dynamic layout rules with main conditions, second conditions, and actions.

minimumByCapability.label: Record type picklist value assignment
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService to create setup-svc /api/recordType/saveDependency-compatible tp_sys_field_dependency plans that replace assigned picklist code values and default value for one record type and dependency field.

minimumByCapability.label: Batch create custom objects with top-level objects[]
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires server-side objects[] batch planning and apply-time per-object PREFIX/DATATABLE_NAME allocation.

minimumByCapability.label: Batch add global select lists and append or merge options
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires server-side globalSelectLists[] precheck, onExisting policies, and optionsMode append/merge/replace handling.

minimumByCapability.label: Batch add fields with server-side slot allocation and existing-target policies
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires server-side fields[] precheck, onExisting policies, safe object-local DATAFIELD_REF allocation, and batched field-row apply.

minimumByCapability.label: Async apply for batch create plans
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService async apply support for objects[], fields[], and globalSelectLists[] batch create plans, returning applyId/operationId for polling.

minimumByCapability.label: Item-level precheck results for batch create plans
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService plan metadata batchItemResults/batchExecutableCount/batchPrecheckFailedCount so independent preflight validation failures do not block unrelated batch items, while apply-time SQL remains batched and transactional.

minimumByCapability.label: Object-scoped batch create for record types, page layouts, validation rules, and buttons
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService compilers to accept recordTypes[], layouts[], validationRules[], and buttons[] under one resolved root object, enforce same-object prechecks, and emit item-level batch metadata.

minimumByCapability.label: Low-code module usability closure for layouts, search layouts, tabs, and record type profile defaults
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService low-code availability closure gates for in-plan default layout placement, record type profile/default/layout fallback, application tab reference validation, search layout enrichment, and profile/application readback evidence.

minimumByCapability.label: Standalone page layout profile and record-type assignment
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService layouts.assign to write tp_sys_profile_layout for explicit profile and optional record-type bindings without coupling assignment to layout creation.

minimumByCapability.label: Company currency and dated exchange-rate low-code domain
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService currency readback, fixed currency compiler, advanced dated-rate compiler, corporate-currency explicit rebase guard, and setup-web/setup-service parity for /api/currency/* company currency management.

minimumByCapability.label: Formula field create persistence with server-side formula compilation
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService to persist formula fields with platform-compatible non-storage metadata, lowercase formula schemefieldName defaults, server-side formulaText to executeExpression compilation, automatic cross-object formula relevance rows in tp_sys_relevance, and specific plan failures for missing object, field, user field, or lookup target metadata.

minimumByCapability.label: Menu object references by object API name and default all-profile visibility
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService to resolve menu object references from object apiName to real object ID/PREFIX, validate supplied object ID or prefix for consistency when present, and default omitted or empty menu/application profile collections to all runtime tp_sys_profile rows.

minimumByCapability.label: API registrar metadata CRUD and readback with runtime debug separation
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService-generated id/apiName, caller-defined or securely generated unique apiCode, DRAFT-on-create/update behavior, logical delete, read-only list/detail endpoints, and rejection of runtime-maintained debug/status fields; debug and log calls remain direct setup-svc runtime operations.

minimumByCapability.label: Fiscal year, fiscal quarter, and area hierarchy low-code domains
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires fiscal year plus child fiscal quarter MetadataService compiler/readback aligned to /api/fiscalYear/queryFiscalYearList, fiscalYearDetail, saveFiscalYear, delFiscalYear, saveFiscalQuarter, and delFiscalQuarter, plus area hierarchy compiler/readback aligned only to /api/area/queryTree, saveArea, and DeleteArea.

minimumByCapability.label: Rollup summary field creation with platform-readable API references and derived runtime SQL
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService to normalize rollup summary summarizedObj/aggregateField into platform-readable API form, parse string conditionVals, derive executeExpression/decimalPlaces/summaryfieldtype, write platform-readable tp_sys_condition MAIN_OBJ_ID/BOOL_FILTER rows and AGGCONDITIONDIS for filtered summaries, store filtered rollup metadata in the expected field shape, support batch fields[] rollup summary creation, and fail closed when filtered summaries lack UI condition rows or SQL conditions.

minimumByCapability.label: Workflow rule CRUD, condition rows, readback, and explicit activation plans
minimumByCapability.reason: Requires MetadataService workflow compiler and read-only /metadata/v1/workflows endpoints aligned to setup-web /api/workFlowSetup/listworkflows, detailWorkflow, saveNewButton, saveWorkflow, deleteWorkflow, and activeWorkflow.

setupSvcCompatibility.policy: When a CLI capability has a recommended setup-svc baseline, record the dependency here and warn during project initialization and config/doctor checks. setup-svc branch versions can be customer-specific, so these checks are advisory and must not block execution by version string alone.

minimumByCapability.label: High-code publish remote validation for classes, triggers, and timers
minimumByCapability.reason: Recommends confirming setup-svc validate endpoint support for /api/ccfag/validate, /api/trigger/validate, and /api/ccPeak/validate.

minimumByCapability.label: API registrar runtime debug/logs and high-code remote invocation adjustments
minimumByCapability.reason: Recommends confirming setup-svc support for the adjusted API registrar runtime and high-code remote invocation contracts.
